description: Release policy for the benchmark artifacts (bench_*.json) under docs/book, read by check_docs.py. An artifact is read_by_page when a book page, a notebook or a release claim (README, CHANGELOG, the scorecard pages) reads a number from it, directly or through an artifact derived from it; check_docs.py fails when such an artifact is older than the code it measures, records no commit, or records a commit outside history. An artifact is historical when nothing reads a number from it and it is only the log of a past run; check_docs.py lists it as a warning when stale. Every tracked artifact must appear in exactly one list, and a historical artifact that a notebook code cell loads or that metadata.mboostrs_artifacts declares is a failure.
